steps.title: Deliver config/accounts-config.yaml with the three mandatory LZA accounts and empty workloadAccounts
steps.intent: Deliver, at the repository-root config/accounts-config.yaml, the LZA accounts-config declaring EXACTLY the three mandatory accounts — Management (organizationalUnit Root), LogArchive and Audit (both organizationalUnit Security) — each carrying a non-empty description and a placeholder email in valid EmailAddress form, with workloadAccounts as an empty list (issue #117; LZACFG-010..013). The file keeps the Phase 0 credential-free posture: the emails are example.com placeholders that deploy nothing (REQ-049/REQ-051). NOTE FOR THE OPERATOR: this exact file already exists on main (delivered by the prior workload lza-phase0-1-redo as part of the six-file config set, PR #116) and is byte-for-byte identical to the reviewed example prototype inputs/lza-phase0/config/accounts-config.yaml, so absent a directed content change this step is a no-op — see q-already-delivered, q-emails, q-descriptions and bc-accounts-already-present. The prototype under inputs/lza-phase0/ is read-only reference; the reserved machinery (.github/**, scripts/**, schemas/**, dashboard/**, package manifests) and the governance record (plans/**, confirmations/**, evidence/**) are out of scope and must not be touched.
steps.acceptance: config/accounts-config.yaml exists at the repository root, parses as YAML, declares exactly three mandatoryAccounts mapping name to organizationalUnit as {Management: Root, LogArchive: Security, Audit: Security}, each account has a non-empty string description and a syntactically valid placeholder email, and workloadAccounts is an empty list.
steps.stand_in: The reviewed accounts-config.yaml already on main (delivered by lza-phase0-1-redo, PR #116) and identical to inputs/lza-phase0/config/accounts-config.yaml: three mandatory accounts Management (Root)/LogArchive (Security)/Audit (Security) with example.com placeholder emails (management+govcloud@example.com, logarchive+govcloud@example.com, audit+govcloud@example.com), current descriptions, and workloadAccounts: []. Used as the defaulted content pending q-already-delivered, q-emails and q-descriptions.

verification_targets.check: config/accounts-config.yaml declares exactly the three mandatory accounts mapping name to organizationalUnit as {Management: Root, LogArchive: Security, Audit: Security}, and workloadAccounts is an empty list (LZACFG-010..013).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; a=yaml.safe_load(open("config/accounts-config.yaml")); m={x["name"]:x["organizationalUnit"] for x in a["mandatoryAccounts"]}; assert m=={"Management":"Root","LogArchive":"Security","Audit":"Security"}, m; assert a["workloadAccounts"]==[]'

verification_targets.check: Each of the three mandatory accounts in config/accounts-config.yaml has a non-empty string description.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; a=yaml.safe_load(open("config/accounts-config.yaml")); ma=a["mandatoryAccounts"]; assert len(ma)==3, len(ma); assert all(isinstance(x.get("description"),str) and x["description"].strip() for x in ma)'

verification_targets.check: Each of the three mandatory accounts has a syntactically valid placeholder email address (a form the pinned LZA v1.16.1 EmailAddress schema accepts), not a ${...} token.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import re,yaml; a=yaml.safe_load(open("config/accounts-config.yaml")); pat=re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$"); assert all(pat.match(str(x.get("email",""))) for x in a["mandatoryAccounts"])'

boundary_cases.description: The deliverable config/accounts-config.yaml ALREADY exists on main (delivered by the prior workload lza-phase0-1-redo as part of its six-file config set, PR #116) and already satisfies issue #117 byte-for-byte. Every verification target above is therefore expected to already hold on the current/frozen plan tree; unless the operator directs a specific content change (see q-already-delivered / q-emails / q-descriptions), the build step is a no-op and build-verify will report action_required for the green targets that also pass on the frozen plan tree. This is a confirm-only workload, not a value rewrite.

config/accounts-config.yaml must declare EXACTLY three mandatoryAccounts — no fourth account and none omitted. A build that adds or drops an account fails delivery even if each account present is individually valid.

Emails must be in valid EmailAddress form: LZA v1.16.1 offline validation rejects ${MANAGEMENT_ACCOUNT_EMAIL}-style tokens, so the working file uses real-format example.com placeholders that satisfy the schema while provisioning nothing under the Phase 0 credential-free posture.
